title: 1326-1328 Fair Avenue (Houses), Columbus, Franklin County, OH
notes: Significance: The building contributes to the Near East Side Historic District, a predominately residential area containing those architectural styles favored by the upper middle class from the 1880s to the 1930s. The Near East Side was one of the city's most fashionable residential areas at the end of the nineteenth century
National Register of Historic Places NRIS Number: 78002063
